arms.A: direct official manual lookup and reopen recheck
arms.B: same-scope search and general model summary
arms.C: full GovIntel public query and browser tracking
arms.C_semantic_off: same C UI, data, tracking and read rules with semantic processing disabled

same_scope_requirements: failures and unknown dates recorded separately from zero events

counterbalancing.assignment: Assign participant index modulo 4 before results exist; record assigned order and deviations.

holdout.gold_labels: Two real independent human reviewers; retain disagreements and adjudication. No model-generated labels as gold.
holdout.rights: Only reviewed licensed public records or project-owned synthetic pilot data; pilot cannot substitute for official holdout.

required_preconditions: A concrete source and field approval receipt has passed compilation; legal scope is source-specific.
Reviewed query/document/model transmission permissions cover each intended arm.
Immutable holdout document versions and timestamps are pinned before model predictions.
The actual C and C_semantic_off product routes are available and validated for the pinned corpus.
Consent and assigned order are recorded privately before the task timer starts.
timing_rules: Use actual browser/server monotonic elapsed time, not intended duration.
Record interruptions and corrections separately; do not silently remove slow or failed tasks.
No simulated users, synthetic timing or Codex decisions count as participants.

metrics.aggregation: Compute explicit denominators and null for zero denominator; separate acquisition gaps, abstentions and answerable tasks.
metrics.public_output: Aggregate counts and ranges only; small group re-identification review required.

next_actual_action: Have real reviewers label a rights-cleared pinned holdout, then invite actual consenting participants after product admission is ready.
